objects.name: New WordPress Click2Shell Flaw Forces Theme Installs, Can Chain to Code Execution
objects.description: WordPress today released patches to fix a new set of vulnerabilities in its core software, one of which could allow a crafted web link, opened by a logged-in administrator, to install a theme from the official WordPress.org directory without anyone clicking Install.
